package: LEAD INTEGRATION (cux-lead): the three reader repairs the package reports left to integration - P2's D7 wiring in P1's parts(), P2's D6 title-branch rule in P1's _on_procedure_line, and P1's rule 2 at P2's own-passage release (_states_unread_act)
summary: Hold-only by construction. L1 opens a report part at a 'Label: <service>' heading of one service (services.labelled_service_heading, P2's unwired helper, tests in test_cux_hold.LabelledServiceHeadingTests): the colonoscopy's titled part no longer runs over a separate same-day flexible sigmoidoscopy note, so that note's biopsy is the flexible sigmoidoscopy's, not the colonoscopy's (R8 D7 / H1: 45380 was READY on a biopsy the colonoscopy never took). L2 reads a report title on a procedure line only in a physician part (as _studies_reported already does): a pathology entry's heading ('PATHOLOGY ADDENDUM - 2026-09-02 hot snare polypectomy specimen') is no procedure title of today's report (R8 D6 / F4C; 45385 is already held there by P2's engine half - L2 removes the act the inventory read from that heading, so the hold now comes from the inventory itself). L3 makes the own-passage release (engine._states_unread_act) read act mentions with services._acts_in, which leaves out an attributive act compound (P1 rule 2: 'biopsy-proven Barrett esophagus', 'a biopsy-confirmed adenoma'), instead of the raw ACTS patterns: such a passage presupposes an earlier act and states none today, and the release had made 43239 READY on it with no act read at all (P1 REPORT risk 1, reproduced by the lead's probe on 8b3efa773: 'Surveillance of biopsy-proven Barrett esophagus was performed.' -> 43239 selected/ready, inventory with no act).
standard: Round-4 (ruling 2026-11-03 (g); R8 section 4): hold-only; a rule that releases a must-stay-held input is stopped and recorded, never forced. L1 adds a part boundary, which can move an act between services - declared rows only; any other movement is a finding.

rules.L1: services.parts(): right after the role-heading check and before PART_NUMBER, a line labelled_service_heading accepts opens a 'report' part of its one family (family and kind_now set, as a report title does). Not a title mark (rule 4's combined-title marks are unchanged).
rules.L2: services._on_procedure_line: its report-title branch applies only when the part's role is 'physician'.
rules.L3: engine._states_unread_act: the passage names the act when services._acts_in(text, reading.start, reading.end) finds a kind the code covers (attributive compounds left out, earlier kinds claim their text), not when any raw ACTS pattern of such a kind matches the passage.
